# Toyota
> Toyota’s official site for researching, shopping, comparing, and owning Toyota cars, trucks, SUVs, hybrids, EVs, and minivans.

Toyota.com combines vehicle research, shopping tools, financing and payment estimators, dealer inventory, ownership resources, safety information, and brand technology content. It covers Toyota’s full lineup, electrified vehicles, performance models, certified used vehicles, and owner support.

## Shopping Tools
- [Shop All Vehicles](https://www.toyota.com/all-vehicles/): Browse Toyota’s full lineup of cars, trucks, SUVs, hybrids, and minivans.
- [Build & Price](https://www.toyota.com/configurator/): Configure trims, colors, packages, and accessories for Toyota vehicles.
- [Search Inventory](https://www.toyota.com/search-inventory/): Find new Toyota vehicles available at nearby dealerships.
- [Compare Models](https://www.toyota.com/compare/): Compare Toyota vehicles by specs, features, dimensions, and pricing.
- [Request a Quote](https://www.toyota.com/dealers/): Connect with local dealers for pricing and availability.
- [Payment Estimator](https://www.toyota.com/payment-estimator/): Estimate monthly payments for financing or leasing a Toyota.
- [Trade-In Value](https://www.toyota.com/trade-in-value/): Estimate the value of your current vehicle toward a Toyota purchase.

## Cars
- [Camry](https://www.toyota.com/camry/): Mid-size sedan with hybrid powertrain, modern styling, and standard safety technology.
- [Corolla](https://www.toyota.com/corolla/): Compact sedan focused on efficiency, value, and everyday practicality.
- [Corolla Hatchback](https://www.toyota.com/corollahatchback/): Compact hatchback with sporty styling and flexible cargo space.
- [Prius](https://www.toyota.com/prius/): Hybrid hatchback with strong fuel economy and distinctive aerodynamic design.
- [Prius Plug-in Hybrid](https://www.toyota.com/priusplug-inhybrid/): Plug-in hybrid offering electric driving capability and hybrid efficiency.
- [Mirai](https://www.toyota.com/mirai/): Hydrogen fuel cell sedan with zero tailpipe emissions and premium features.
- [GR Supra](https://www.toyota.com/grsupra/): Performance coupe engineered for speed, handling, and driver engagement.
- [GR86](https://www.toyota.com/gr86/): Lightweight sports coupe with rear-wheel drive and balanced handling.

## SUVs & Crossovers
- [Corolla Cross](https://www.toyota.com/corollacross/): Compact crossover combining efficiency, utility, and available all-wheel drive.
- [Corolla Cross Hybrid](https://www.toyota.com/corollacrosshybrid/): Hybrid crossover with added power and improved fuel economy.
- [RAV4](https://www.toyota.com/rav4/): Popular compact SUV with versatile cargo space and multiple trims.
- [RAV4 Hybrid](https://www.toyota.com/rav4hybrid/): Hybrid SUV pairing utility with strong fuel efficiency.
- [RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid](https://www.toyota.com/rav4plug-inhybrid/): Plug-in hybrid SUV with electric range and quick acceleration.
- [Highlander](https://www.toyota.com/highlander/): Three-row SUV designed for family comfort and everyday capability.
- [Grand Highlander](https://www.toyota.com/grandhighlander/): Larger three-row SUV with expanded passenger and cargo room.
- [4Runner](https://www.toyota.com/4runner/): Body-on-frame SUV built for off-road capability and durability.
- [Sequoia](https://www.toyota.com/sequoia/): Full-size SUV with three-row seating, towing, and hybrid power.
- [Land Cruiser](https://www.toyota.com/landcruiser/): Heritage SUV focused on off-road performance and rugged utility.
- [bZ4X](https://www.toyota.com/bz4x/): Battery-electric SUV with available all-wheel drive and modern technology.
- [Crown Signia](https://www.toyota.com/crownsignia/): Premium crossover with elevated styling and hybrid efficiency.

## Trucks & Vans
- [Tacoma](https://www.toyota.com/tacoma/): Mid-size pickup with off-road trims, utility features, and available hybrid power.
- [Tundra](https://www.toyota.com/tundra/): Full-size pickup with strong towing capability and available i-FORCE MAX hybrid.
- [Sienna](https://www.toyota.com/sienna/): Hybrid minivan with family-focused seating, storage, and available all-wheel drive.

## Electrified Vehicles
- [Electrified Lineup](https://www.toyota.com/electrified/): Overview of Toyota hybrid, plug-in hybrid, battery-electric, and fuel cell vehicles.
- [Hybrid Vehicles](https://www.toyota.com/electrified/hybrid/): Explore Toyota hybrid models and hybrid system benefits.
- [Plug-in Hybrid Vehicles](https://www.toyota.com/electrified/plug-in-hybrid/): Learn about Toyota plug-in hybrid models and charging flexibility.
- [Battery Electric Vehicles](https://www.toyota.com/electrified/battery-electric-vehicles/): Overview of Toyota EV technology, charging, and electric models.
- [Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles](https://www.toyota.com/electrified/fuel-cell-electric-vehicles/): Information on hydrogen fuel cell technology and Mirai.
- [Electrified Benefits](https://www.toyota.com/electrified/benefits/): Compare ownership advantages across Toyota electrified powertrains.

## Performance & TRD
- [Toyota GR](https://www.toyota.com/gr/): Home for Toyota Gazoo Racing performance vehicles and motorsports-inspired engineering.
- [GR Corolla](https://www.toyota.com/grcorolla/): High-performance hot hatch with turbo power and all-wheel drive.
- [GR86](https://www.toyota.com/gr86/): Driver-focused sports coupe with lightweight chassis and manual transmission availability.
- [GR Supra](https://www.toyota.com/grsupra/): High-performance coupe with powerful engines and track-ready dynamics.
- [TRD Pro Series](https://www.toyota.com/trdpro/): Off-road-focused Toyota models with upgraded suspension and trail equipment.

## Safety & Technology
- [Toyota Safety Sense](https://www.toyota.com/safety-sense/): Suite of driver-assistance and active safety technologies across Toyota models.
- [Safety Connect](https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/safety-connect/): Emergency assistance and vehicle support through connected services.
- [Remote Connect](https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/remote-connect/): Remote vehicle access and controls through the Toyota app.
- [Service Connect](https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/service-connect/): Vehicle health reports and maintenance alerts for eligible models.
- [Drive Connect](https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/drive-connect/): Cloud navigation, voice assistant, and connected driving features.
- [Audio Multimedia](https://www.toyota.com/audio-multimedia/): Toyota infotainment platform with connectivity and app integration.
- [Connected Services](https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/): Overview of Toyota subscription-based connected vehicle features.

## Owners
- [Owners Home](https://www.toyota.com/owners/): Central hub for Toyota owner resources, account access, and vehicle information.
- [Maintenance Schedule](https://www.toyota.com/owners/parts-service/maintenance-schedule): Find recommended maintenance intervals for Toyota vehicles.
- [Service Centers](https://www.toyota.com/dealers/service-centers/): Locate Toyota dealerships offering maintenance and repair services.
- [Manuals & Warranties](https://www.toyota.com/owners/warranty-owners-manuals/): Access owner’s manuals, warranty guides, and related documents.
- [Recalls](https://www.toyota.com/recall): Check for Toyota safety recalls and service campaigns.
- [ToyotaCare](https://www.toyota.com/toyotacare/): Learn about included maintenance and roadside assistance coverage.
- [Roadside Assistance](https://www.toyota.com/owners/roadside-assistance): Get help with roadside support for eligible Toyota vehicles.
- [Toyota App](https://www.toyota.com/owners/toyota-app/): Manage connected services, payments, and vehicle information from mobile devices.

## Finance, Lease & Protection
- [Toyota Financial Services](https://www.toyota.com/financial-services/): Financing, leasing, and account services for Toyota customers.
- [Finance a Vehicle](https://www.toyota.com/financial-services/finance/): Learn about Toyota auto financing options and application steps.
- [Lease a Vehicle](https://www.toyota.com/financial-services/lease/): Explore Toyota lease options, terms, and end-of-lease information.
- [Apply for Credit](https://www.toyota.com/financial-services/apply-for-credit/): Start a Toyota financing or leasing credit application online.
- [Special Offers](https://www.toyota.com/deals-incentives/): View current Toyota deals, incentives, and regional offers.
- [Vehicle Protection Plans](https://www.toyota.com/financial-services/vehicle-protection-plan/): Review optional coverage products for Toyota ownership.
- [Guaranteed Auto Protection](https://www.toyota.com/financial-services/guaranteed-auto-protection/): Learn about GAP coverage for financed or leased vehicles.

## Certified Used Vehicles
- [Toyota Certified Used Vehicles](https://www.toyotacertified.com/): Shop Toyota certified used vehicles with warranty-backed inspection standards.
- [Search Certified Inventory](https://www.toyotacertified.com/inventory): Browse certified used Toyota inventory by model and location.
- [Certification Warranty](https://www.toyotacertified.com/warranty): Review warranty coverage included with Toyota certified used vehicles.
- [Certified Benefits](https://www.toyotacertified.com/benefits): Learn about inspections, roadside assistance, and ownership benefits.
- [Certified Vehicle Specials](https://www.toyotacertified.com/offers): Explore offers and incentives on certified used Toyota vehicles.

## Brand & Company
- [About Toyota](https://www.toyota.com/about/): Overview of Toyota’s brand, values, and company information.
- [Toyota Newsroom](https://pressroom.toyota.com/): Official news, announcements, product reveals, and corporate updates.
- [Careers](https://www.toyota.com/careers/): Explore employment opportunities and working at Toyota.
- [Motorsports](https://www.toyota.com/racing/): Toyota racing programs, teams, and motorsports involvement.
- [Toyota USA YouTube](https://www.toyota.com/video/): Video content featuring vehicles, technology, and brand stories.
